caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented object that resembles an ornate glass lamp or bottle with an empty, transparent upper section. The base is a square platform with beveled edges, supporting a vertically ribbed, conical section that expands outward as it rises, then narrows into a smaller, segmented cylindrical piece. Above this is a rounded, bulbous main chamber with gentle vertical ribbing and a smooth finish, topped with a threaded opening or neck. The drawing is rendered in shades of grey and black on a beige background, using precise lines and shading to emphasize the transparency and reflective qualities of the object. In the lower right corner, there is the handwritten text “JOHN DANA AP.24.1936,” indicating the artist and the date. In the lower left is a small, simple linear scale.
title: Lamp
